Does Brad Pitt die in The Mexican?

He plays Jerry Welbach.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Delivers the cursed pistol, keeps the girl, drives into the sunset.

Bungling errand boy Jerry is sent to Mexico to retrieve the legendary 'Mexican' pistol while his girlfriend Sam is held by hitman Leroy. Bodies drop around him, including Leroy and mob boss Margolese's rival, but Jerry survives every mishap, returns the gun to Margolese, and ends the film on the road with Sam.
